what: a line drawing of what the story is about, drawn by the writer (art.GUIDE); it builds up stroke by stroke
use_when: the story is about a thing that can be drawn in lines (a pipe, a bus, a school)
avoid_when: crime, deaths, or nothing to draw
rules: at most one "draw" scene; it is the drawing of what the story is about (see the drawing guide below);
